feature.description: Register datasets, schemas, fields, versions, sources, quality states, dependencies, and relationships to business concepts.

contract.purpose_user_function: Register datasets, schemas, fields, versions, sources, quality states, and dependencies as a connected graph.

contract.success_evidence: No current direct evidence. Future proof requires durable dataset nodes/edges with version, schema, quality, lineage, and query tests.
